minimumSealClass.description: Optional. Seals of a lower class, or with no class, are refused with 409 `seal-class-too-low`. Left out = no minimum.

requireSecuringBeforeDoorWork.description: Optional. When true, door work starts only on a secured trailer (409 `trailer-not-secured`; ADR 0013). Left out = false.

allowHazmatOnUnclassifiedSpots.description: Optional. When true, a trailer with a hazard class may take a spot of unknown kind at a site with no HAZMAT spot (ADR 0014). Left out = false.
